reasoning_content: The event service is currently running. I'll check the overall health and test the ping endpoint, which pings all dependent services:

action.command: cd /workspace && sleep 30 && docker compose ps --format "table {{.Name}}\t{{.Status}}" | sort; echo "=== event ping ==="; docker exec workspace-event-1 node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:7004/test/ping', res=>{let d='';res.on('data',c=>d+=c);res.on('end',()=>console.log(res.statusCode, d.slice(0,400)))}).on('error',e=>console.log('ERR',e.message))"

tool_call.name: terminal
